sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next upgrades the model systematically along four aspects — attention, residual, embedding and optimization — improving model capability while further optimizing computational efficiency, model capacity and training stability: Attention A GDN + QSA hybrid architecture.

sources.title: How to Run Qwen3.8 Flash Next Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 Flash Next is the first open model built on the Qwen4 architecture that you can run locally: a 125B Mixture-of-Experts model that activates 6B parameters per token and runs from a 64 GB MacBook up, with its 51B n-gram table paged from SSD. sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a new open-weight, 125B parameter MoE multimodal model from Qwen. Built on the new Qwen4 architecture, it supports a 262K context window and advanced reasoning. The model outperforms Claude-4.6-Opus (Max) and can run locally on devices with 75GB RAM /unified memory with no GPU VRAM required.
